rule: A restricted or partial edit's right-answer count on hard328 with the cue is the average of two covariate fits to the stored hard328 cue counts (T 1.0, v3, seed 3000000). Fit A: interpolate linearly on the stored dial curve of right answers against edit scale (base 0x 164, top-8 at 1x 192, 1.5x 203, 2x 190). The input is the edit's scale along the stored 1.5x edit, 1.5 x sqrt(kept share), which is the plain norm arithmetic for a projected edit rescaled to the 1.5x norm. Fit B: interpolate linearly on right answers against the share of the 1.5x edit kept, using stored partial edits at 1.5x (the three layer bands, each about 1/3 of the edit: 184, 183, 166, mean 177.7) and the full edit (share 1: 203). The kept share for each common-subspace dimension m comes from the stored weights table (result-ce52f8, mean of the reader and writer shares). The 90% interval is about +/-13 to 15 right answers. That covers the one-sample noise of these cells (stored contrasts under about 5 points are not resolved; the SE of one count is about 9) plus the gap between the two fits.
